en.title: Distant-Water Profile of a Country
en.description:
This function follows the marine catch of one country over time in the FAO major fishing
areas it borders (adjacent areas) and in the areas it does not border (distant-water areas),
and counts the FAO areas in which it fishes each year, as a measure of the spatial expansion of
its fisheries. It also lists, for each distant-water area, the first and last year with catch,
the peak and the recent catch.
en.details:
Distant-water catch is defined as by FAO: the catch of a country in the FAO major fishing areas
it does not border; fishing outside its own waters but in an area it borders does not count
(Grainger and Garcia 1996, section 2.6; Garibaldi and Limongelli 2003, section 2.1). An area is
adjacent to a country as in `coastal_distant()`: the country's land, including overseas
territories, lies within 20 km of the FAO area boundary (a rule of this package). FAO records catch by the flag
of the vessel and by FAO major area, not by exclusive economic zone (EEZ), so the split shows in
which FAO areas a country's fleet fished, not whether the catch came from its own waters, the
waters of other countries or the high seas. Swartz et al. (2010) mapped the spatial expansion
of world fisheries with Sea Around Us catch maps; this function uses FAO statistics only, at
the resolution of FAO major areas.

For China, FAO notes that in 2022 China reported 2.3 million tonnes of distant-water catch but
gave species and areas only for the catch landed in China (area 61); FAO filled other areas
with data from regional fisheries management organizations and entered 1.3 million tonnes as
"Marine fishes nei" in area 61 (FAO 2024). Recent distant-water catch of China is therefore
partly counted in its adjacent area 61.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list with `yearly` (catch in adjacent and distant-water areas, distant-water
share and number of areas fished, by year), `areas` (one row per FAO area fished) and
`distant` (yearly catch by distant-water area).

arguments.country_name: The country, as named in the FAO data (e.g. "China", "Spain").
arguments.top_n:
The number of distant-water areas shown separately; the others are combined.
Default is 8.
arguments.min_catch:
An area counts as fished in a year when the country's catch there is above
this many tonnes. Default is 0 (any reported catch).
arguments.plot: A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in `figures/png/summary/`.
arguments.table: A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in `tables/`.
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
"both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
`figures/pptx/summary/`. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with
`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.
arguments.label:
The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the
country) of the data.
arguments.data_version: The FAO data release to use; see `load_fao_data()`.

zh.title: 一个国家的远洋捕捞概况
zh.description: 本函数追踪一个国家的海洋渔获量随时间的变化，分为其毗邻的FAO主要渔区（邻近渔区）和不毗邻的渔区（远洋渔区），并统计其每年在多少个FAO渔区捕捞，作为其渔业空间扩张的衡量指标。它还为每个远洋渔区列出有渔获量的第一年和最后一年、峰值和近期渔获量。
zh.details:
远洋渔获量采用FAO的定义：一个国家在其不毗邻的FAO主要渔区中的渔获量；在本国水域以外、但在其邻近渔区中的捕捞不算远洋捕捞（Grainger和Garcia，1996，第2.6节；Garibaldi和Limongelli，2003，第2.1节）。渔区是否与一个国家毗邻的判定与`coastal_distant()`相同：该国陆地（包括海外领地）位于该FAO渔区边界20公里以内（本包的规则）。FAO按船旗国和FAO主要渔区记录渔获量，而不是按专属经济区（EEZ）记录，因此这种划分显示的是一个国家的船队在哪些FAO渔区捕捞，而不是渔获来自本国水域、他国水域还是公海。Swartz等（2010）用Sea Around Us的渔获量地图描绘了全球渔业的空间扩张；本函数只使用FAO统计数据，分辨率为FAO主要渔区。

关于中国，FAO指出，2022年中国报告了230万吨远洋渔获量，但只为在中国上岸的渔获量（61区）给出了物种和渔区；FAO用区域渔业管理组织的数据填补了其他渔区，并把130万吨作为"Marine fishes nei"（未另列明的海洋鱼类）计入61区（FAO，2024）。因此，中国近年的远洋渔获量有一部分被计入其毗邻的61区。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包括`yearly`（逐年的邻近渔区和远洋渔区渔获量、远洋渔获量占比和捕捞的渔区数）、`areas`（每个有捕捞的FAO渔区一行）和`distant`（各远洋渔区的逐年渔获量）。

arguments.country_name: 国家，名称与FAO数据中的一致（例如"China"、"Spain"）。
arguments.top_n: 单独显示的远洋渔区个数，其余渔区合并显示。默认为8。
arguments.min_catch: 一个国家某年在某渔区的渔获量超过这一吨数时，该渔区才算当年有捕捞。默认为0（任何报告的渔获量）。
arguments.plot: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。
arguments.table: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。
arguments.label: 输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为该国家的名称（`country_name`）。
